selectors.rule:
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .eyebrow,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .story-copy .eyebrow,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .story-subtitle,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .story-note,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .form-intro,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .auth-form label small,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .auth-switch,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .privacy-note,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .username-input > span,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .chat-row-copy small,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .chat-row-meta,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .list-section-label,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .inbox-footnote,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .empty-title,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .composer-hint,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .message-time,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .message-edited,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .message-meta strong,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .conversation-identity-button,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .profile-avatar-actions > span { color: var(--color-text-secondary); }

:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .auth-form input,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .profile-form input,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .profile-form textarea,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .profile-form select,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .username-input { color: var(--color-text-primary); background: var(--color-bg-surface); border-color: var(--color-border); }

:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .auth-form input::placeholder,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .profile-form input::placeholder,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .profile-form textarea::placeholder,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .message-composer textarea::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-secondary); }

:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .auth-form input:focus,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .profile-form input:focus,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .profile-form textarea:focus,
:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .username-input:focus-within,

:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .overlay { background: var(--color-overlay); }

:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .muted,

:root:is([data-theme], :not([data-theme])) .profile-form .profile-checkbox > input { accent-color: var(--color-primary); }
.auth-panel h2, .account-dialog h2 { margin: 0; color: #25362e; font-size: var(--type-display); font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -.8px; }
.auth-form, .profile-form { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 17px; }
.auth-form label, .profile-form label { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; }
.auth-form label > span, .profile-form label > span { color: #3e4a43; font-size: var(--type-body-xs); font-weight: 600; }
.auth-form input:focus, .profile-form input:focus, .profile-form textarea:focus { border-color: #7e9a7c; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(93, 128, 91, .12); }
.auth-form input::placeholder, .profile-form input::placeholder, .profile-form textarea::placeholder { color: #aab2ac; }
.form-error { padding: 10px 11px; border: 1px solid #f1d0c8; border-radius: 7px; color: #963f35; background: var(--color-danger-soft); font-size: var(--type-body-xs); line-height: 1.5; }

.workspace.has-active-space .inbox-pane,
.workspace.has-active-space .conversation-pane,
.workspace.has-active-updates .inbox-pane,
.workspace.has-active-updates .conversation-pane { display: none; }
.workspace.has-active-updates { grid-template-columns: 72px minmax(0, 1fr); }

.updates-page { display: flex; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; grid-column: 2 / -1; grid-row: 1; flex-direction: column; overflow-y: auto; padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 42px); color: var(--color-text); background: var(--color-canvas); }
.group-space-upgrade-dialog { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.space-dialog-overlay { z-index: 45; overscroll-behavior: contain; }
.space-dialog { width: min(440px, calc(100vw - 30px)); max-height: min(760px, calc(100dvh - 32px)); overflow-y: auto; }
.space-dialog-copy { margin: -5px 0 18px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-size: var(--type-label); line-height: 1.55; }
.space-dialog-copy strong { color: #42634a; }

.space-dialog-members { display: flex; max-height: 190px; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; overflow-y: auto; margin: 12px 0 18px; padding: 9px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 8px; }
.space-dialog-members > div, .space-dialog-members > div > span { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; }
.space-dialog-members > div { min-width: 0; min-height: 35px; }
.space-dialog-members > div > span { min-width: 0; flex: 1; align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.space-dialog-members strong { max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; color: var(--color-text); font-size: var(--type-label); text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.space-dialog-members small { color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-size: var(--type-small); }
.space-invite-dialog-form { margin-top: 0; }
.space-invite-dialog-form .space-channel-grants { max-height: 150px; overflow-y: auto; }
.space-settings-dialog { container-type: inline-size; display: flex; width: min(850px, 100%); height: min(680px, calc(100dvh - 40px)); flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; padding: 0; }
.space-settings-content .profile-form { max-width: 520px; }
.space-settings-content .space-dialog-members { max-height: 180px; margin-top: 0; }
.space-channel-settings-dialog { width: min(560px, 100%); }
.space-object-dialog { width: min(500px, calc(100vw - 30px)); }
.space-message.is-update-target { border-radius: 8px; outline: 2px solid #93bd8d; outline-offset: 6px; }
.shared-object-card { width: min(100%, 480px); margin-top: 8px; padding: 13px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--color-surface); }
.shared-object-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.shared-object-heading > span:nth-child(2) { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.shared-object-heading > span:nth-child(2) strong { color: var(--color-text); font-size: var(--type-label); }
.shared-object-heading > span:nth-child(2) small { color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-size: var(--type-caption); }
.shared-object-icon { display: grid; width: 31px; height: 31px; flex: 0 0 auto; place-items: center; border-radius: 8px; color: #42634a; background: #e9f0e7; }
.shared-object-action { display: grid; width: 30px; height: 30px; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; }
.shared-object-action:hover { color: var(--color-text); background: var(--color-surface-muted); }
.shared-object-card h3 { margin: 10px 0; color: var(--color-text); font-size: var(--type-body); line-height: 1.35; text-wrap: pretty; }
.shared-object-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; margin-top: 10px; }
.shared-object-footer > small { color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-size: var(--type-small); }
.shared-object-detail { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin: 8px 0; color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-size: var(--type-label); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.shared-object-card blockquote { margin: 8px 0 0; padding: 8px 10px; border-left: 3px solid #88a486; border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0; color: var(--color-text-secondary); background: var(--color-surface-subtle); font-size: var(--type-label); line-height: 1.5; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.shared-object-completed { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; margin: 10px 0 0; color: #398153; font-size: var(--type-small); }
.updates-header { display: flex; max-width: 1180px; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; margin: 0 auto 22px; width: 100%; }
.updates-header .eyebrow { margin: 0 0 5px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-size: var(--type-small); letter-spacing: .08em; }
.updates-header h1 { margin: 0; color: var(--color-text); font-size: var(--type-display); text-wrap: balance; }
.updates-header > div > p:last-child { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-size: var(--type-label); }

.updates-search { display: flex; min-width: min(340px, 40%); min-height: 39px; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 0 9px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); background: var(--color-surface); }
.updates-search:focus-within { border-color: #8ba289; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(93 128 91 / 10%); }
.updates-search input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; color: var(--color-text); background: transparent; font: inherit; font-size: var(--type-label); }
.updates-search button { padding: 5px 7px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; color: #315a40; background: #edf3ec; font: inherit; font-size: var(--type-small); cursor: pointer; }
.updates-filters { display: flex; max-width: 1180px; gap: 7px; width: 100%; margin: 0 auto 20px; }

.updates-filters button { min-height: 30px; padding: 5px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 18px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); background: var(--color-surface); font: inherit; font-size: var(--type-small); cursor: pointer; }
.updates-filters button:hover, .updates-filters button.is-active { color: #315a40; border-color: #d8e5d5; background: #e9f2e7; }
.updates-sections { display: flex; max-width: 1180px; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; }
.updates-section > header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 11px; }
.updates-section > header > span { display: grid; width: 34px; height: 34px; place-items: center; border-radius: 9px; color: #42634a; background: #e9f0e7; }
.updates-section > header > div { min-width: 0; flex: 1; }
.updates-section > header h2 { margin: 0; color: var(--color-text); font-size: var(--type-body); }
.updates-section > header p { margin: 3px 0 0; color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-size: var(--type-small); }
.updates-section > header b { color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-size: var(--type-small); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.updates-empty { margin: 0; padding: 14px 16px; border: 1px dashed var(--color-border); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-size: var(--type-label); }
.updates-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 340px), 1fr)); gap: 11px; }

.updates-live-call { display: flex; min-height: 58px; align-items: center; gap: 11px; margin-bottom: 10px; padding: 10px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--color-surface-subtle); }
.updates-live-indicator { width: 9px; height: 9px; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 50%; background: #36a66b; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgb(54 166 107 / 13%); }
.updates-live-call > div { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; }
.updates-live-call strong { overflow: hidden; color: var(--color-text); font-size: var(--type-label); text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.updates-live-call small { color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-size: var(--type-small); }

.updates-live-call button { min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--color-text); background: var(--color-surface); font: inherit; font-size: var(--type-small); font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }
.updates-live-call button:hover { border-color: #b7cfb9; background: #eef5ed; }
.updates-item { min-width: 0; padding: 11px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--color-surface-subtle); }
.updates-item-context { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; overflow: hidden; color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-size: var(--type-small); }
.updates-item-context strong { overflow: hidden; color: var(--color-text); text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.updates-open-source { margin-top: 9px; padding: 4px 2px; border: 0; color: #42634a; background: transparent; font: inherit; font-size: var(--type-small); font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }
.updates-open-source:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

.updates-saving { position: fixed; right: 20px; bottom: 18px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--color-text); background: var(--color-canvas); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgb(0 0 0 / 10%); font-size: var(--type-small); }
